card.title: KATALINA
card.text: Gets +2+2 when an enemy countermeasure triggers.
card.flavorText: The Consolidated PBY Catalina was an American flying boat and amphibious aircraft that was first introduced in 1936. It was provided to the Soviet Union through the Lend-Lease program and served as their primary naval reconnaissance and bomber aircraft during and after WWII. It proved so successful that it remained in service long after the war, with planned replacements such as the Be-6 never fully taking over its role. The Soviet Union received 185 Catalinas, including both amphibious and tricycle landing gear variants, which were well regarded by Soviet naval pilots. These versatile aircraft continued to be used for bombing and rescue operations until they were finally retired from service between 1954 and 1957.
